questions.text: How does Zowi decide what to answer?

answers.text: He knows the answers because he is a fortune-telling robot.
He is programmed to decide at random.
He is programmed to change his answer every three taps.

questions.text: Is it possible for Zowi to always answer Yes in mode 1?

answers.text: It is very, very difficult, but it could happen.
If the battery is low, it will always happen.
